```{r}
#| label: themes-and-helpers
# Helper function for sample sizes
calculate_sample_sizes <- function(data) {
  data |>
    group_by(
      REFERENCE_ID,
      OCEAN_COUNTRY,
      SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE,
      ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB
    ) |>
    summarise(total_n = sum(MEASURED_N, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

```

# Network Diagram

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-heatmap-unique-site-compartments
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

unique_compartments_and_sites <- literature_merged_data |>
  select(
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE,
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_SUB,
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT,
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB,
    MEASURED_N
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))) |>
  group_by(
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE,
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_SUB,
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT,
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB
  ) |>
  reframe(sum_n = sum(MEASURED_N)) |>
  mutate(compartment_name_n = glue::glue("{ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB}\n{sum_n}"))

# Prepare summary data
compartment_site_summary <- unique_compartments_and_sites |>
  group_by(SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE, ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB) |>
  summarise(n_samples = sum(sum_n), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate text color threshold
threshold_value_comp <- mean(
  log10(compartment_site_summary$n_samples),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Calculate ordering
site_order <- compartment_site_summary |>
  group_by(SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n_samples)) |>
  arrange(total) |>
  pull(SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE)

compartment_order <- compartment_site_summary |>
  group_by(ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n_samples)) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  pull(ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB)

# Create complete grid with wrapped text
compartment_site_complete <- compartment_site_summary |>
  mutate(
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_wrapped = str_wrap(SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE, 30),
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB_wrapped = str_wrap(ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB, 20)
  ) |>
  complete(
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_wrapped = str_wrap(site_order, 30),
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB_wrapped = str_wrap(compartment_order, 20),
    fill = list(n_samples = 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_wrapped = factor(
      SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_wrapped,
      levels = str_wrap(site_order, 30)
    ),
    ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB_wrapped = factor(
      ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB_wrapped,
      levels = str_wrap(compartment_order, 20)
    )
  )

# Plot heatmap
compartment_site_complete |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB_wrapped,
    y = SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE_wrapped,
    fill = n_samples
  )) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = if_else(n_samples > 0, scales::comma(n_samples), ""),
      color = if_else(
        n_samples > 0 & log10(n_samples) > threshold_value_comp,
        "black",
        "white"
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", na.value = "grey90") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```

For the sake of starting somewhere, we can start by defining each combination of compartment and site type in coastal, estuary, and marine water as a node.

  ```{r}
coastal_complex_combinations <- compartment_site_summary |>
  filter(
    SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE %in%
      c("Coastal, fjord", "Ocean, sea, territorial waters", "Estuary")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    SITE_x_SUB = glue("{SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE} x {ENVIRON_COMPARTMENT_SUB}")
  )


```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| width: 20
#| label: fig-network-diagram

ggraph(graph, layout = "tree") +
  geom_edge_diagonal2(
    aes(label = flow_type),
    colour = "darkgrey",
    label_colour = "black",
    strength = 0.8,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    angle_calc = "along",
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')),
    start_cap = circle(10, 'mm'),
    end_cap = circle(10, 'mm')
  ) +
  geom_node_point(size = 20, aes(colour = name)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = str_wrap(name, 10)), size = 3, ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_colours) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
